A new Fighter starts with four items: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches**.

**Where it's defined**
- `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65` maps each class to item IDs. The Fighter entry is `[2, 15, 17, 23]`.
- A helper in the same file (around lines 74–83) inserts one row per ID into `character_inventory`. Each row has quantity 1 and `equipped = 0`, so nothing starts equipped.
- `createCharacter` (`character.ts:14`) is the caller.

**ID to name mapping**
The seed data is in `worker/src/db/seed.sql`, and the IDs are positional autoincrement values. `worker/src/db/seed.md` and `docs/flows/character-creation.md` document the mapping:

| ID | Item | Seed range |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | Longsword | weapons, 1–10 |
| 15 | Shield | armor, 11–16 |
| 17 | Potion of Healing | potions, 17–21 |
| 23 | Torches | misc, 22–28 |

I confirmed the IDs in the code. I took the ID-to-name mapping from the docs and did not open `seed.sql`.

The code comment on line 66 says `23` is "Rations", but by seed order `23` is Torches and Rations is `24`. The docs track this as bug B-09. The Fighter gets Torches in practice.

Other Fighter starting values:
- d10 hit die
- base AC 16
- 50 gold
